meta.title: Trip through Georgia: Field notes
meta.song: music/Mumford & Sons - The Cave (Official Music Video).mp3

shots.sync: intro: blank sketchbook; the title writes itself on the first strum, 'this book belongs to Tom & Sam' + km 0 on bar 0
'It's empty in the VALLEY of your heart': the old-town rooftops sketch themselves in, colour floods in on 'valley'
'The SUN, it rises slowly as you walk': the first colour of the film, blooming slowly over the line
'Away from all the fears': the Chronicles; 'And all the faults': the two of you on its stairs + your note; the page holds through 'you've left behind'
'The harvest left NO FOOD': Tom on his phone at an empty plate, 'food?' + arrow; 'MEAT-EATER': the meat platter sketches in on 'You' and floods with colour on 'meat-eater'
'But I have seen the same': a night page, the lamp and the TV tower over the cathedral courtyard across the spread
chorus 1 'But I will hold on HOPE': Sameba drawn in white pencil on 'But', blooming gold on 'hope'
'And I won't let you choke': back to day, the Dry Bridge market; the drinking horn lands on 'noose'
'And I'll find strength in pain': the panorama from the hike, half coloured, slow push
'And I will CHANGE MY WAYS': before (khachapuri hair) -> the Mafia Barbershop on 'ways' -> after on 'know'; 'my NAME': red 'Sam?'
bar 18: rental rule no. 1: NO OFFROAD; the road sketches itself in pencil -> KICK DRUM IN (bar 19): red 'Yes, no offroad.' and the colour floods the picture: a tyre stuck in a pothole in the road
bars 21-23: 14.10., your 'Gamarjoba' lunch stop: Sam and the cat; the khinkali lands on bar 22 with your note and the khinkali tally (day 3)

layers.text: Amai dit eten was crazy goed

shots.sync: bars 24-25: the flag over the Gudauri valley fills the page; your selfie lands on a loose page on bar 25, on the left, so the flag stays in view
''Cause I have other things to FILL my time': two stray dogs asleep in Gergeti; 'z z z' on 'fill'
'You take what is yours and I'll take MINE': dinner, an evening page; your label 'Vlees'; Sam behind the meat tower, red 'mine.' + arrow
'Which will REFRESH my broken mind': Gergeti Trinity under Kazbek, pencil -> colour on 'refresh'; 2,170 m counts up, the red route Tbilisi -> Gergeti draws itself, km 214
'So tie me to a POST': 15.10., your label 'The border': Sam's stop hand at the sign, Tom at the other sign on 'post'
'I can see widows and orphans through my tears': Dariali monastery, tiny under its mountain, fills the page (a landscape hold)
'I know my call despite my faults': Tom and Sam on the giant stone heads, both up for the whole line

'And despite my GROWING fears': the larches fill the page and flood with orange by bar 41; Sam leaping the river on a loose page, a pencil arc traces the jump on 'growing'; the page holds through the instrumental
chorus 2 'But I will hold on hope': 16.10., your label 'Stalin top G'; Sam's thumbs-up, Tom's hand on heart
'And I won't let you choke': the statue, Stalin's railway carriage on beat 3
bars 47-48: the Lenin & Stalin carpet across the spread
'And I'll find strength in pain': the rock-cut tunnel stairs at Uplistsikhe fill the page, slow push
'And I will change my ways': your label 'Crazy city', the cave town; Sam on the rock on bar 51
'I'll know my name as it's called again': Tom small on the Uplistsikhe plateau
verse 3 'So come out of your CAVE': 17.10., Prometheus cave; Tom's cave selfie blooms on 'cave'

'And see the world hanging UPSIDE DOWN': the stalactite hall drawn upside down; on 'up-side-down' the whole book turns 180° (lifted off the desk mid-turn) and the cave hangs the right way, 'this way up'
'When you know the maker's land': still underground, a black page: the lit cave halls, both up for the whole line
'land': Khoni, the Kinchkha falls and the pool (both up for the whole page)
'So make your SIREN'S call': Tom crouched on the white rock in the pool, red 'siren.' + arrow
'And SING all you want': Tom under the icy waterfall (clip 8.6 s ->)
'I will NOT HEAR what you have to say': 18.10., the Kutaisi market; the phrasebook: gamarjoba on 'hear', madloba on 'say', line 3 stays empty ('?')
'Cause I need freedom NOW': Sam driving the rental; the red route so far draws itself to Kutaisi, km counts up
'To LIVE MY LIFE as it's meant to be': Tskaltubo starts with the NO ENTRY tape; red 'Yes, no entry.' on 'life'
brass bars 69-70 (page turn on the downbeat): Tom and a stray dog at the abandoned station (clip 6.0 s ->), the station
bars 71-72: the two of you in the sanatorium: Sam in the window, Tom on the broken landing
bars 73-74: the tree inside the rotunda fills the page
bars 75-76: 19.10., Batumi's upside-down house: 'not the book this time.'
bars 77-79: Abastumani, a night page: Sam at the eyepiece and Tom under the big telescope; the moon they were looking at lands between them on bar 78
bars 80-81: 20.10., Vardzia: the arch, and the whole cliff of caves

final chorus: the checklist page (one line per sung phrase, red ticks; the khinkali tally completes 12 strokes; 'we made it.'; Tom signs on 'my', Sam on 'name') while the right page paints the last days, one per 2-3 bars
the last chord: a page turn on the band's last hit; the whole loop draws itself in red ink over the ring-out, a small painting lands per beat; silence: 'madloba!', 'Thank you Georgia', '— Tom + Sam'
